description: Checks what an AI agent can do with a business's website: message, book, order, sign up, pay, change or cancel. Waits up to 25 seconds; if the read isn't finished, returns what it found so far, and you call it again for the score. A result read in the last hour is answered as it is; after a business changes its site, set fresh to true to read it again (allowed a few minutes after the last read). A done result also carries door_history: what this network's own reads found of the site's doors, kept for good: when each was seen answering and on how many days, and for a door read every day (a member's, a claimed listing's), from 14 days checked, the share of days every check answered, as a count and a share ("answered 41 of 42 days (97%)"): a day with a failed or a refused check counts as a missed day, and a refused one is shown as refused. Use it when a person asks how agent-ready a business is, or wants to improve their own. To find businesses, use search_businesses instead. A setup link in the answer is for the owner to fill in themselves. Capability ids are defined at https://surfingdog.ai/spec/capabilities/.

fresh.description: Read the site again rather than answer the stored result: for a business that just changed its site. Allowed a few minutes after the last read; before that, the stored result is answered with when to ask again.

url.description: The business's website, as a URL or a bare domain like salon.example.

name: check_business

answers.description: Message, book, order, sign up, cancel and negotiate, in that order.

via.description: The tool, skill, operation or field it was read from.

door_history.description: Every door type at every host of the site a read of the network's found answering (§4.8).

as_of.description: The UTC day it was read on.

checks.description: A door the network reads every day (a member's, a claimed listing's), from 14 checked days.

answered.description: Of them, days on which every check answered: one missed check (failed, or blocked while the door is down by the network's reads) makes the day missed, and one refused check (blocked otherwise) makes it refused.

days.description: Days checked: days on which the network's daily read of the door concluded. A read an agent's report or the business asked for is no check.

recent.description: The last 90 days ending on as_of, oldest first: a every check answered, x one was missed, b one was refused and none missed, . no check that day.

refused.description: Of them, days on which a check was refused and none was missed: never answered days.

current.description: Whether a door of this type is at this host now (not gone).

days_seen.description: On how many days a read of the network's found it answering: a door read about once a month is seen on few days, and nothing is said of the days between.

first_seen.description: The first UTC day a read of the network's found a door of this type at this host answering.

summary.description: With checks, in English: "Answered every check on 41 of 42 days checked since 3 Oct 2026 (97%).", the share floored, the days refused after it ("(75%; refused our check on 5)"), "from … to …" when the last check is more than 7 days old. Informative: another network may word it its own way.

with.description: What the fix brings with it (changing and cancelling a booking), counted as yes in its points.

manage.description: The owner's page (/b/<domain>/owner): claim, correct or hide, with no AI and no account.

pay_with.description: How the business is paid, each way with its evidence: declared by the business, or seen on its own pages and files.

label.description: Its English name: Apple Pay for apple_pay.

url.description: The page, file, profile, manifest or door the evidence is at.

via.description: Where the evidence is: registration, manifest, schema_org, ucp, acp, door, file or page today. A later network may add one: read a via you do not know as evidence of its src.

queue.description: Only while queued, checking or scoring.

rank.description: Only when done, not hidden and of a kind the directory ranks.

report.description: Report how each use of a door went, done or not: see the guide.

guide.description: How to report, for an agent: <network>/report.md.

reward.description: What the agent gets for reporting, in one sentence.

tool.description: The MCP tool that takes door reports: report_door.

track_record.description: A member's track record, from the same nightly count as its standing and shown under the same rules: the promises it kept and broke, and when. From rules version 8, one that rests on the business's own word is self_reported: its counts, with no score and no count of customers. Only what its state can say is present; a business that is not a member has none.

as_of.description: The nightly count it is from (00:00 UTC).

broken.description: shown: closed as not kept by the business or by a customer's report that stands, left open 9 days past due, or a refund paid late.

closed.description: gathering and shown: kept plus broken.

confirmable.description: shown: whether this network can verify any acknowledgement yet (a recognised platform's agent key, or an established person's).

confirmed.description: shown: how many of the closed are kept outcomes a verified acknowledgement backs, confirmed by the customer's side (a customer's report is not a confirmation); the rest are the business's own word.

customers.description: gathering and shown, unless self_reported: the distinct customers the closed promises came from, as its receipts name them (the customer's mailbox when known, else, before rules version 8, the receipt's sub; from rules version 8 a sub that names no person is never a customer, and every receipt at a business that names nobody is one anonymous customer). Not reputation.customers, which counts only customers this network can tell apart.

from.description: shown: the earliest day of the evidence counted, at 00:00 UTC (a day, never the moment of a promise).

held_until.description: held: the night its record is counted from.

in_words.description: The record in one or two plain sentences, with how many of its closed promises the customer's side confirmed; the rest are the business's own word.

open.description: shown, from rules version 8: its v2 promises still open (reputation.open).

refunds_late.description: shown, of broken: refunds paid late (refund.late).

self_reported.description: gathering and shown, from rules version 8: the record rests on the business's own word (less than a fifth of it is kept outcomes a verified acknowledgement backs, as its reputation's self_reported), so it has no customers, and its threshold none.

state.description: held: a new member's 30 days after it joins, when nothing is counted; none: no receipts yet; pending: receipts the next nightly count reaches; gathering: fewer closed promises, or customers, than threshold; shown: the record.

threshold.description: What a record shows from: closed promises, from customers distinct customers; a self_reported record is not asked for customers, and has none here.

to.description: shown: the latest day of the evidence counted, at 00:00 UTC (a day, never the moment of a promise).

unclosed.description: shown, of broken: left open 9 days past due (promise.unclosed).

title: Check a business's website
